label: Call Activity
description: Begins another workflow as a step here, and carries on once it finishes.

message.label: Message
message.description: The name of the request that starts the other workflow, e.g. "createVersion".

subject.label: Subject
subject.description: Which resource the call acts on: "created" for what the execution created, if anything, or else the event's target (the default); "target" for the event's target even after a creation.
